_comment: The absolute-path check asks whether a fresh clone can run without any path
under someone's home directory existing. Code, documentation, recipes and
Records of runs that already happened are different: an exported Abaqus job
names the directory it ran in, and rewriting that would falsify the record.
Such directories are exempt below, each with its reason. No exemption may
cover anything a reproduction reads as input.

absolute_path_exemptions.reason: records of runs that already happened (commands, working directories, environments and outputs of the 2026-09-18 audits and gates); rewriting their paths would falsify them, and no reproduction reads them as input
the committed record of the presentation-claims run (verification/run_all.py writes the same file into --out); it names where that run found its inputs, and nothing reads it as input

report written by examples/finite_strain_c3d8/benchmark.py with the environment it ran in; regenerated by every run and never read as input (the config, model and params beside it are inputs and stay checked)
